verdicts.title: Complexity of Satisfiability in Kochen-Specker Partial Boolean Algebras
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The Kochen-Specker no-go theorem established that hidden-variable theories in quantum mechanics necessarily admit contextuality. This theorem is formally stated in terms of the partial Boolean algebra structure of projectors on a Hilbert space.
